title: The Diary of a Young Girl
author: Anne Frank

beats.event: Given a diary as a 13th-birthday present
Begins writing about school, family and friends
Notes tightening Nazi laws: yellow star, curfews
Sister Margot receives a Nazi work-camp summons
Family flees into hiding in the sealed annex
Van Pels family joins them in the annex
Dentist Fritz Pfeffer arrives to share her room
Consolidates her letters into ones addressed to 'Kitty'
Documents deportations and rumors of gassing
Constant friction with her mother and the adults
Radio broadcast inspires her to write for publication
Begins revising her diary as a future book
Grows close to Peter van Pels, hoping for a kindred spirit
Concludes Peter cannot really be that kindred spirit
Writes her final entry, still believing people are good
